normal.name: Chrizzly
normal.text: Initially I streamed Half Life Alyx via PC (CachyOS) to my #steamframe, but after a few bugs (sometimes when a Barnacle dies the game crashed), I gave the standalone version on the frame a chance. Have played it that way since the first 2 hours ingame and I'm really impressed how good the game looks rendered on the frame. You lose a tiny bit of fidelity, but it is still really immersive that way! Impressive! #steam #halflifealyx
